summary: Tested all 7 requested features: Submissions XLSX export, Project Earnings CRUD + GST calc + totals, Projects P&L tab (summary cards, per-project earned/net, expand earnings+expenses), /admin/live Today's Sessions card (checked-in = on-time + late, not-in, scheduled total). All backend (8/8 pytest) and all frontend flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectEarnings.jsx GST compute uses Math.round(amount*pct)/100 which handles 18% of 5000 -> 900 exactly, but for amounts with decimals this rounds to nearest paisa pair (acceptable). Backend uses round(amount*pct/100, 2) - two formulas agree for integer amounts (verified).

Project earnings uses PUT (not PATCH) for update - requires full EarningIn payload. Frontend sends full form so OK. Keep consistent naming (earnings uses PUT, milestones/kb use PATCH) - minor inconsistency.
live_dashboard _sessions_block: checked_in=on_time+late invariant enforced by construction - verified via snapshot API (23 checked-in = 19 on-time + 4 late; 31 total = 23 checked-in + 8 not-in).
ProjectsPnLTab fetches /earnings for every project in parallel via Promise.all - fine for small N but will N+1 scale badly if projects count grows large; consider a single aggregated endpoint later.
AdminLive /admin/live route is public (no auth required per code comment) which is intentional per code - FYI.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed changes - pytest created & deleted its own earnings; UI flow created 'Test Client UI' earning then deleted it (clean). Only remaining earning is the pre-existing 'Test Client' / 12,000 on project 7ff3645b.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified live-dashboard sessions block (today 2026-10-14): checked_in=23 (on_time=19 + late=4), not_checked_in=8, total=31. Projects P&L sign convention: grandNet<0 renders 'Net Loss' with -prefix amount; per-project net uses teal (positive) / red (negative). Export XLSX filename format: techfest-submissions-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx. ProjectEarnings endpoints: POST /api/projects/{pid}/earnings, PUT /api/projects/earnings/{id}, DELETE /api/projects/earnings/{id}, GET /api/projects/{pid}/earnings - all return gst_amount & total_amount computed server-side.
